_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "Wise account: Wise uses SWIFT codes tied to banks in the United States and the European Union. For personal accounts, the SWIFT must match the country of registration; therefore, producers located outside the U.S. and the EU cannot use Wise accounts for withdrawals. For business accounts outside Brazil, the SWIFT may belong to other countries; therefore, a Wise business account can be used for payouts."
_extraction_context.subject_exact: Hotmart restricts Wise personal account withdrawals to US/EU-registered producers — non-US/EU personal accounts ineligible; Wise business accounts outside Brazil are eligible regardless of SWIFT country
